citation: Feng Y, Li J, Yin H, Shen J, Liu W. 2024. Multi-omics analysis revealed the mechanism underlying flavonol biosynthesis during petal color formation in Camellia nitidissima. BMC Plant Biology 24:847.
source_role: CnFLS2 source identity, petal expression/function and published primer provenance
exact_claim_supported: CnFLS2 is the petal-expressed FLS paralog in the source study; transient CnFLS2 overexpression increases flavonol; the project links the source F01 PacBio transcriptome to SRR22729450.
claim_boundary: Source article does not itself identify the current GWH genome locus; that mapping is the project's public-data inference.

citation: Wang et al. 2025. A telomere-to-telomere genome assembly of Camellia nitidissima. Scientific Data.
source_role: Public C. nitidissima genome/annotation used for the unique primer-compatible CnFLS2 candidate and local context
exact_claim_supported: Provides the public T2T genome and annotation from which GWHTFILD005297.1 / GWHPFILD005297.1 are recovered.
claim_boundary: Genome source alone does not label GWHTFILD005297.1 as the Feng F01.PB8395 transcript; that identity is resolved by primer and source-read evidence.

citation: Zhou XW, Fan ZQ, Chen Y, Zhu YL, Li JY, Yin HF. 2013. Functional analyses of a flavonol synthase-like gene from Camellia nitidissima reveal its roles in flavonoid metabolism during floral pigmentation. Journal of Biosciences 38:593-604.
source_role: Independent CnFLS1 sequence/function reference used to distinguish the CnFLS2-like lineage
exact_claim_supported: CnFLS1 is a functional FLS reference; overexpression increases flavonols and reduces anthocyanins.
claim_boundary: CnFLS1 is a comparator, not the Feng 2024 CnFLS2 source target.

citation: Tateishi N, Ozaki Y, Okubo H. 2010. Molecular Cloning of the Genes Involved in Anthocyanin Biosynthesis in Camellia japonica. Journal of the Faculty of Agriculture, Kyushu University 55(1):21-28.
source_role: Primary C. japonica CjDFR clone and assay source
exact_claim_supported: The partial CjDFR clone is 605 bp, encodes 201 aa, is deposited as AB524885, and the source RT-PCR primer pair delimits the published target.
claim_boundary: Partial CDS only; does not prove identity of every later generic CjDFR assay.

citation: Berruti A, Christiaens A, De Keyser E, Van Labeke M-C, Scariot V. 2015. Cold Treatment Breaks Dormancy but Jeopardizes Flower Quality in Camellia japonica L. Frontiers in Plant Science 6:983.
exact_claim_supported: The reported CjDFR qPCR primer pair is 167 bp and maps exactly to AB524885.1 in the project audit.
claim_boundary: Corrects the historical internal LARCHER2015 assay label; supports assay-to-sequence linkage, not DFR paralog classification by itself.

citation: Mei X, Zhou C, Zhang W, Rothenberg DO, Wan S, Zhang L. 2019. Comprehensive analysis of putative dihydroflavonol 4-reductase gene family in tea plant. PLOS ONE 14(12):e0227225.
exact_claim_supported: Distinguishes canonical CsDFRa (AB018685.1/TEA032730) from putative CsDFRb1-b3/CsDFRc/CsDFRd and maps XM_028243762.1 to CsDFRb2/TEA024758.
claim_boundary: Putative DFRb biochemical activity is not assumed equivalent to canonical CsDFRa; the project uses subclass identity, not functional equivalence.

citation: Zhou C, Mei X, Rothenberg DO, Yang Z, Zhang W, Wan S, Yang H, Zhang L. 2020. Metabolome and Transcriptome Analysis Reveals Putative Genes Involved in Anthocyanin Accumulation and Coloration in White and Pink Tea (Camellia sinensis) Flower. Molecules 25(1):190.
source_role: Source expression contrast for tea DFR/ANS-family changing loci
exact_claim_supported: Pink-specific anthocyanins and source-reported DFR/ANS/LDOX expression differences provide the independent tea micro cluster used for later sequence-class resolution.
claim_boundary: Expression annotation is not accepted as exact paralog identity without the separate TPIA/sequence-class audit.

citation: Geng F, Nie R, Yang N, Cai L, Hu Y, Chen S, Cheng X, Wang Z, Chen L. 2022. Integrated transcriptome and metabolome profiling of Camellia reticulata reveal mechanisms of flower color differentiation. Frontiers in Genetics 13:1059717.
source_role: Independent C. reticulata ANS-family expression/effect contrast
exact_claim_supported: Anthocyanins and most anthocyanin-pathway expression follow red > pink > white in the source contrast; project re-analysis resolves copy-aware mapped features.
claim_boundary: Tea-reference-mapped feature IDs are not species-native C. reticulata ortholog accessions.

citation: Qu Y, Ou Z, Yong QQ, Yao X, et al. 2024. Coloration differences in three Camellia reticulata Lindl. cultivars: ‘Tongzimian’, ‘Shizitou’ and ‘Damanao’. BMC Plant Biology 24:18.
exact_claim_supported: Red and white petal regions differ in anthocyanin-pathway expression; ANR is elevated in the white region in the admitted project evidence.
claim_boundary: Corrects the historical internal study label 'Xu2023'; supports family/copy directional heterogeneity but not macro recurrence or adaptive causation.
